info.title: Avi Tenant Object API
info.description:
Avi Tenant object api
```
- configure tenant <key>
- show tenant <key>
```

API permission: PERMISSION_TENANT

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: object name

parameters.name: refers_to
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that refers to another Avi resource. Its syntax is refers_to=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all virtual services referring to pool p1 will be refers_to=pool:pool_p1_uuid

parameters.name: referred_by
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that are referred by another Avi resource. Its syntax is referred_by=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all pools referred_by virtual service vs1 - referred_by=virtualservice:vs_vs1_uuid

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of fields to be returned for the resource. Some fields like name, URL, uuid etc. are always returned.

parameters.name: include_name
parameters.description: All the Avi REST reference URIs have a name suffix as URI#name. It is useful to get the referenced resource name without performing get on that object.

parameters.name: skip_default
parameters.description: Default values are not set.

parameters.name: join_subresources
parameters.description: It automatically returns additional dependent resources like runtime. Eg. join_subresources=runtime.

parameters.name: X-Avi-Tenant
parameters.description: Avi Tenant Header

parameters.name: X-Avi-Tenant-UUID
parameters.description: Avi Tenant Header UUID

parameters.name: X-Avi-Version
parameters.description: The caller is required to set Avi Version Header to the expected version of configuration. The response from the controller will provide and accept data according to the specified version. The controller will reject POST and PUT requests where the data is not compatible with the specified version.

parameters.name: X-CSRFToken
parameters.description: Avi Controller may send back CSRF token in the response cookies. The caller should update the request headers with this token else controller will reject requests.

vs_limit.description: Maximum number of Virtual Services allowed for this tenant. -1 as Default is maximum value, set to 0 to disallow any VS creation. Allowed values are -1-+65535. Field introduced in 31.3.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

created_by.description: Identifies the user type that created the configuration. Nil for non-service users. Enum options - SERVICE_USER. Field introduced in 31.3.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

version.description: Version sequence number that monotonically advances with each configuration update event. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

key.description: Key. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

value.description: Value. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

limit.description: Maximum license service units allowed for consumption. -1 as Default is maximum value. Allowed values are -1-+65535. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

reservation.description: Minimum license service units reserved for consumption. Reservation is not enforced for Tenant/SE Group. Allowed values are 0-65535. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

_last_modified.description: UNIX time since epoch in microseconds. Units(MICROSECONDS).

attrs.description: Key/value tenant attributes. Field introduced in 30.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

config_settings.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

configpb_attributes.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

created_by.description: Creator of this tenant. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

description.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

enforce_label_group.description: The referred label groups are enforced on the tenant if this is set to true.If this is set to false, the label groups are suggested for the tenant. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

label_group_refs.description: The label_groups to be enforced on the tenant. This is strictly enforced only if enforce_label_group is set to True. It is a reference to an object of type LabelGroup. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

local.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

name.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

uuid.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

app_quota.description: Application quota for the tenant. Field introduced in 31.3.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

license_quota.description: License quota for the tenant. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

se_in_provider_context.description: Controls the ownership of ServiceEngines. Service Engines can either be exclusively owned by each tenant or owned by the administrator and shared by all tenants. When ServiceEngines are owned by the administrator, each tenant can have either read access or no access to their Service Engines. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

tenant_access_to_provider_se.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

tenant_vrf.description: When 'Per Tenant IP Domain' is selected, each tenant gets its own routing domain that is not shared with any other tenant. When 'Share IP Domain across all tenants' is selected, all tenants share the same routing domain. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

key.description: Label key string. Field introduced in 20.1.2. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

value.description: Label value string. Field introduced in 20.1.2. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.
